description: A tall upright sleeping bag shaped like a capsule with a rounded top and bottom. A curled hood opening sits at the top, and two horizontal lines cross the lower body like zip or quilting seams.
A ridge tent seen in three-quarter view: a triangular front face on the left joined by a sloping roof panel running back to the right. Two curved door flaps part at the base of the front face.
A symmetrical tent with a pitched roof whose eaves extend past short vertical walls on both sides. A pointed arch door opening sits centred on the front, rising from the base.
A seated rower leans forward in a flat-topped boat, arms reaching toward an oar that crosses the hull on a diagonal. A wavy water line runs beneath the boat, overlapping its lower edge.
A double-bladed paddle stands upright on the left beside a canoe seen from above on the right. The canoe tapers to a pointed bow at the top and has a small oval seat hole in its middle.
A crouching figure faces right with a rectangular backpack on its back and bent legs mid-stride. A band crosses the head for a headlamp, and two diverging beam lines shine forward from the brow.
A standing person on the left extends one arm holding an axe whose head overlaps the trunk of a tall pine tree on the right. The tree has stepped layers of branches and a straight trunk.
Two tall tapered swim fins stand side by side, one widening downward and one inverted. Each has a rounded foot pocket opening at its narrow end and a single straight rib running along the blade.
A dome-topped buoy floats on two wavy water lines, with a band across its base. A tall pole rises from the dome top carrying a small pennant flag with a notched tip pointing right.
A diver swims diagonally downward beneath a wavy surface line, body extended from a round head at right to a fin at upper left. A vertical line drops from the surface at the right edge.
A horizontal belt strap passes through a central rounded buckle marked with two short vertical slots. Two rounded weight blocks hang below the buckle on short straps, side by side.
An upright teardrop-shaped spoon lure hangs from a small ring at the top. A double hook curls upward in two symmetrical barbs from a short shank beneath the spoon.
A person seated on a low stool at right holds a long fishing rod that arcs up and over to the left. A small fish hangs head-down from the line at the far left.
A standing person on the left raises one arm to hold the straight shaft of an open umbrella. The umbrella canopy arches above and to the right with a scalloped lower edge and a small top tip.
A tall tapering four-sided obelisk with a pointed pyramidal cap stands on a low rectangular plinth. The plinth has a horizontal band across it and a wider base line beneath.
A standing figure statue rests on a tapered pedestal above a ground line. A flag pole leans diagonally beside the figure, carrying a rectangular flag at its upper right.
Two tall slightly tapered standing stones support a wide horizontal lintel stone laid across their tops, leaving an open gap between the uprights. The lintel overhangs both stones a little.
An upright rounded backpack with a flap lid across the top and a square pocket buckle at its centre. Side pockets bulge out on both sides, and a short horizontal line marks the front pocket.
A person sits on a bench seen from the side, leaning forward with forearms resting on a picnic table to the right. The table has a flat top and splayed legs.
An upright camping lantern with a flared cap on top, a narrow glass chimney holding a teardrop flame on a stem, and a wider rounded fuel base banded with a circular valve at its centre.
A squat oil lantern with a narrow cap and handle band on top, a wide bulging glass body with a curling flame inside, and a flat base foot beneath. The body sides curve outward symmetrically.
A flashlight lies on a diagonal from lower left to upper right, its narrow handle carrying a small switch and widening into a flared head. Two short light marks shine beyond the lens.
An upright flashlight with a wide rectangular lens head at the top that narrows through a tapered collar into a rounded handle. A small oval switch sits on the handle.
A climbing rope coiled into a figure-eight of two long loops on a diagonal from lower left to upper right. Several wraps bind the coil tightly around its narrow waist.
A simple house with a pitched roof, straight walls and a centred rectangular doorway. A flagpole rises from the right slope of the roof carrying a small rectangular flag.
A minimal lean-to shelter in side view: a single roof line slopes up from a short vertical post at left to the upper right, above a long horizontal ground line joined to the post.
A hatchet angles down from the upper left with its blade head at the top. Three chipped fragments of wood scatter below the blade, two triangular and one curved crescent.
A triangular sail floats above a flat-decked hull with sloped ends, separated from it by a clear gap. A single wavy water line runs beneath the hull.
A single tall sail with a straight mast edge and a curved bellied leech rises above a flat-decked hull with sloped ends. A wavy water line runs beneath the boat.
A round buoy half-submerged in a wavy water line, with the waterline crossing its lower half. A straight pole rises from the top carrying a triangular pennant pointing right.
A kayaker leans back in a sharply tilted kayak rising from wavy water, gripping a double-bladed paddle held on a diagonal. The body, boat and paddle overlap densely and are hard to separate.
A person in a small boat at lower left tows a tow line running diagonally up to a round-headed parasailer. A half-dome parachute canopy with scalloped ribs opens above them at upper right.
A rounded inflatable raft seen from above, with a thick outer tube around an inner capsule crossed by two seat bands. A single-bladed paddle stands upright to its right.

concept: Person in Crane Pose with Bird
description: A person balances on one leg with the other knee raised and both arms spread wide. A ground line runs beneath, and a small bird in flight glides at the upper left.
A standing person at lower left points up at an easel board on the right. The board shows a winding S-shaped route ending at an X mark, and a single leg supports it below.
A hiker with a backpack leans into a steep climb, legs bent on a rising diagonal ground line. One arm reaches forward to plant a trekking pole on the slope.
A walking hiker with a rectangular backpack strides to the right. One bent arm grips a long trekking pole that runs diagonally from above the hand down to the ground ahead.
A walking hiker with a rectangular backpack strides forward, one arm stretched out level to rest a hand on top of a short cane. The cane angles down to the ground ahead of the front foot.

concept: Hiker with Staff on a Step
description: A hiker with a backpack steps up with one knee raised onto a short ledge. Both hands grip a tall vertical staff standing straight upright in front of the body.

concept: Beach with Palm Tree and Sun
description: A curved palm tree at left bends its fronds over a sandy shoreline curve. A wavy sea line runs across the middle, and a small rayed sun shines at the upper right.
